name: High priority case created for Perry Watts
description: High priority case created for Perry Watts

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_created
FROM customer_case
WHERE case_id = 1233
  AND account_id = 30
  AND contact_id = 64
  AND product_id = 17
  AND channel = 'email'
  AND priority = 'high'
  AND state = 'in_progress' ;

name: Verify KB article is linked to the case
description: Verify KB article is linked to the case

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_kb_link_exists
FROM case_knowledge
WHERE case_id = 1233
  AND knowledge_id = 27
  AND used_as = 'suggested';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sla_def_response_exists
FROM sla_definition
WHERE sla_def_id = 2
  AND name = 'SLA Response - High'
  AND metric = 'response'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sla_def_resolution_exists
FROM sla_definition
WHERE sla_def_id = 7
  AND name = 'SLA Resolution - High'
  AND metric = 'resolution';
